strings.game.descent.banner_dog: A Gudauri dog is running with you
strings.game.descent.banner_powder_text: Slows you down. You can jump over it
strings.game.descent.banner_snowcat_text: Coming up the run. Jump over it
strings.game.descent.banner_wind_text: Hold the button: crouch against the wind
strings.game.descent.canvas_label: The game: a skier going down a run
strings.game.descent.coach_air_flip: In the air: hold to flip
strings.game.descent.coach_release_hint: The longer you hold, the higher you jump
strings.game.descent.coach_release_line: Let go on the yellow line!
strings.game.descent.controls_note: One button, or tap anywhere on the screen. Keyboard: Space.
strings.game.descent.copied: Copied. Paste it in the group.
strings.game.descent.copy_note: On the site itself the link will include your run, and friends will race your ghost.
strings.game.descent.end_all_crew: The whole crew made it to the lift!
strings.game.descent.end_new_best: New best on this run! Next time you'll race its ghost.
strings.game.descent.end_reached_lift_all: You made it to the lift!
strings.game.descent.end_reached_lift_you: You made it to the lift!
strings.game.descent.how_hold_text: Like real skiing: crouch before the jump. It also makes you faster and steadier against the wind.
strings.game.descent.how_release_text: The longer you crouch, the higher you jump. Let go on the yellow line before a kicker: "perfect pop". In the air, hold again: flip.
strings.game.descent.intro: Gudauri's real runs, at their real steepness. Pick up the crew on the way, jump over gullies and snowcats, do flips, and outrun the avalanche to the lift.
strings.game.descent.jump_hint: Crouch, then let go to jump
strings.game.descent.legend_gully: Gully: jump just before the edge
strings.game.descent.legend_khachapuri: Khachapuri: points, lots of them above the kickers
strings.game.descent.legend_snow: Deep snow slows you, ice speeds you up
strings.game.descent.legend_snowcat: Snowcat: coming up the run, jump high
strings.game.descent.legend_wind: Wind on the ridge: hold on the snow
strings.game.descent.meta_description: A ski game on Gudauri's real runs
strings.game.descent.profile_note: Each run's profile is measured from the elevation model along its real line (OpenStreetMap), every 5 meters, exaggerated 1.5×, and the altitude in the corner is the real one. Wind and fog appear only above 2,900 m, like on the ridge. The kickers, gullies and obstacles were added for the game.
strings.game.descent.share_caught: The avalanche caught {name} on {run} after {m} m. Who gets further?
strings.game.descent.share_result: {name} did {run} in {time} {stars}: flips {flips}, perfect pops {pops}, crew {got}/5, khachapuri {coins}. Who can beat that?
strings.game.descent.title: The Crew's Descent
